message:
🚀 Flex GUI Pro — Version 6.5.3 Official Release Notes
This major release consolidates extensive AutoCaptions regional updates, native color sampling pipelines, slider scrubbing performance optimizations, and cookie authentication downloader overrides.

♦️ AutoCaptions Ecosystem Overhaul
1. Comprehensive 99+ Language Support
Whisper Core Expansion: Expanded the localized captioning framework to natively parse all 99+ international and regional languages supported by OpenAI's Whisper model, adding full structural integration for major regional scripts (e.g., Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Urdu, Punjabi, etc.).

Searchable Dropdown Menu: Built an intuitive, custom searchable dropdown component matching dark theme aesthetics, complete with live query filtering and instant transition states to locate targets immediately.

2. Transcription Memory & Formatting Utilities
Subtitle Fill Gaps Toggle: Added a 'Fill Gaps' script option. When enabled, it passes a configuration flag to the background execution to automatically bridge empty caption spaces under 2.0 seconds, eliminating visual flashing.

Project Directory Auto-Saving: Subtitle outputs are now compiled and written as localized .srt files straight into your active After Effects project folder automatically upon generation success.

Transcription History Cache: Implemented a historical data dropdown menu to securely store, review, and re-load text records and time codes from your last 15 Whisper caption loops.

Style Panel & Persistence Memory: Integrated an inline font property and layout scaling editor inside the panel interface. Added an environment cache script to keep panel metrics, sizes, and sliders identical across re-opens.

♦️ Creative Pipelines & Optimization
3. 4-Color Gradient Native AE to SaaS Palette Engine
Active Sampling Script: Added an ExtendScript function to query active timeline layers for the native After Effects ADBE 4ColorGradient effect and translate color arrays into hex formats.

Custom Local Storage Logic: Engineered a pulsating save button to capture native gradients and permanently save them directly inside custom SaaS color palette arrays in localStorage.

4. Zero-Lag Slider Scrubbing Performance Patch
Dedicated Panel Undo Button: Integrated a built-in undo utility shortcut to clear history stack buildup and resolve intermediate timeline lag generated during active property slider dragging adjustments.

5. Downloader & AI Core Utilities
Global Cookie Downloader Matrix: Added custom structural cookie fields to the Reference tab downloader, bypassing authorization protocols to easily download Instagram Reels, private video links, and multi-platform media directly onto your timeline.

Local Image Generation Directories: The AI Assistant tab now supports local installation file routing, empowering editors to deploy and run image generation models 100% offline on local hardware.

Trim to Below Layer Modifier: Added a layout shortcut execution button to immediately cut and snap target layer end boundaries to match the layer block sitting below them.
